acceptable_paraphrases: The numbers 102 and 222 are divisible by 3
Numbers 102, 222 can be divided by 3 without remainder
Only the numbers 102, 222 meet the criteria for divisibility by 3
misconceptions: All given numbers are divisible by 3
Only one or more than two numbers out of the three provided are divisible by 3
The answer should include a number not in the list (e.g., 103, 222 is incorrect)
grading_notes: Correct answers must explicitly state that only 102 and 222 are divisible by 3. Any other combination or phrasing indicating divisibility of all numbers or a number not in the list will be considered incorrect.
